headline: REPAIR CONFIRMED (SIP-7): the one number is 1, ENFORCED — the external anchor check detects both forged registries (fingerprint divergence from the DOI-bound record) without trusting local git; the maximal attacker must now ALSO defeat Zenodo, an immutable external surface outside keys+commit. Local software layers still fall (FD-1/FD-2 fail as found, unchanged — that is GOV-3's floor); boundedness and the honest audit trail still hold even under total compromise (FD-3); and the final floor is now machine-checkable, not just human review. Previous finding (DHB-3):  the whole system's final floor as ONE NUMBER, and the number is 0: with both keys and git commit access on both planes simultaneously, ZERO software layers resist — the forged relaxed roster verifies in-process (stolen key + committed registry), all 40 minted records pass the signed-issuance gate, and the brain under the forged governance heals aggressively while remaining bounded (the clamp holds even the maximal attack: sick, but honest). The forgery is attributable in retrospect, but the attacker's commit access forges the ledger trail too, and the one attacker-independent immutable surface — the DOI-bound Zenodo record set — currently binds none of the anchor files. The floor is human review over append-only history, with no machine-checkable external anchor. SIP-7 CANDIDATE: ANCHOR BINDING — bind the anchor fingerprints (issuance_registry.json, gov_release_registry.json, gov_key_pin.txt) into the DOI-bound BINDINGS record at every release, so the maximal attacker must additionally defeat Zenodo to erase forensics; the one number becomes 1, and it is ENFORCED, not assumed.

disclosed_instrument_defects_fixed_betwe: Run-1 keys-in-clone defect: the attack read both stolen keys from production custody but never placed them in the attacker clone — both planes then failed CLOSED on missing key files (governance: 'key_unavailable -> halt_escalate'; data: registry unverifiable -> nothing issued), producing false 'HELD' verdicts that were actually fail-closed artifacts, not defense. The falsifiers printed 'fail as found, as predicted' regardless of the measured verdict — a framing bug on top. Both fixed: keys copied into the clone (the attacker holds them by definition), prints derived from the measurement. LESSON recorded: a maximal-attacker battery whose attacker forgot their own keys measures the fail-closed design, not the floor.

GOV-3's floor is now measured COMPOSED on both planes at once: keys+commit defeats every software layer; only external immutability + human review remain. All data synthetic.
